name: devdogs-monorepo
description: Minimal DevDogsUGA-shaped workspace, committed as a fixture for devtools' contract tests (packages/devtools/test/contract). Never installed or built directly — the contract test suite copies this into a temp directory, injects `pnpm.overrides` pointing at freshly-packed @devdogsuga/devtools and its published dependencies, and `pnpm install`s that copy. See test/contract/README.md.
